title: Canonical pullback on topological object cohomology
statement: For a continuous map $f:X\to Y$ of topological spaces, use inverse image of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] and object cohomology $H^p(V,A)$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. The canonical object-cohomology pullback is the unique family $H^p(V,A)\to H^p(f^{-1}V,f^{-1}A)$ characterized by naturality in $A$, commutation with connecting maps of short exact sequences and agreement in degree zero with the inverse-image adjunction unit, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback-data]. Choose this family using the existence theorem [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback-exists]; [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback-unique] determines it uniquely. The abelian inverse image is left adjoint to direct image and additive; these structures are taken from the adjunction and preservation of finite limits.
